info.name: Internship Opportunity Portal API
info.description:
Covers every endpoint in the PRD (Section 14) with at least one success (2xx) and one failure (4xx) case each, including duplicate application (409), unauthorized (401), and forbidden (403) scenarios.

Run `npm run seed` against a fresh database before running this collection top-to-bottom - folders are ordered so the right session cookie (student vs admin) is active when each request needs it. Postman's cookie jar is shared per-domain, so re-running out of order (or re-running only part of the collection) may leave the wrong role's cookie active for a given request.

request.description: Assumes the seed script has already created priya@college.edu.
Business Rule 7: role is never client-settable; unknown fields fail schema validation.
Sets the JWT httpOnly cookie for subsequent student-role requests in this collection run.

item.name: 1b. Setup - Admin Creates a Dedicated Apply-Flow Test Listing

request.description: Deadline is set ~36h out (a synchronous pre-request script, unlike the async pm.sendRequest issue above) so it falls inside the default 48h notification window once the notify job runs.

item.name: Re-login as student (back to student session for the rest of the flow)

request.description: Verifies skill-alias normalization (JS -> JavaScript, Node -> Node.js) from the seeded SkillSynonym data.

exec: pm.test("skills normalized to canonical form", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.skills).to.include("JavaScript"); });

request.description: In the Postman app, attach a .exe or .txt file to the 'resume' form field before sending to see the 400. Attach a real .pdf to the same field on a duplicated request to see the 200 + addedSkills success case.

A real prior request rather than a pre-request-script side effect - pm.sendRequest() in a prerequest script isn't reliably awaited before the main request fires, so the logout needs to be its own sequenced step.

item.name: Get internship detail (authenticated, with match score) - success (200)

request.description: Uses the dedicated listing from folder 1b, not one of the seed script's internships (the seeded student already has applications on those).

item.name: Apply again to same internship - duplicate (409)

request.description: Business Rule 2: only one non-Withdrawn application per (user, internship) pair, enforced by a DB partial unique index.

item.name: Get another user's application - not found (404)

request.description: 404 (not 403) so existence of another user's resource isn't leaked (Section 15).
Business Rule 3: only Applied/Shortlisted applications can be withdrawn.
Business Rule 2: re-applying after withdrawal is explicitly allowed.

item.name: Login as admin (temporary, to trigger the job)
Re-login as student (back to student session)

exec: pm.test("at least one deadline_reminder notification exists", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some(function (n) { return n.type === "deadline_reminder"; })).to.eql(true); });
var target = pm.response.json().data.find(function (n) { return n.type === "deadline_reminder"; }); if (target) pm.collectionVariables.set("notificationId", target._id);
